contract_c_basis: RL legacy_public_holding -> (public_noindex, noindex); IP-16.2 pre-ratification public routes only
meaning: Every page publicly deployed before Gate 12, with its substantive-body hash and the directives it was SERVED with (robots, sitemap membership, canonical). It is the status-quo record for the publication-authority resolver: a legacy page may keep at most these directives (never escalate) while its body is unchanged. Entries with g != PASS are the Gate-12 legacy hold. The list may only shrink.
